title: The Sound of Spring on the Breeze

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ryan racks up the wins. Gone is the self-doubting Umamusume who once worried she was unworthy of the Mejiro name.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She races with pure determination, focusing exclusively on victory. It seems that watching Ines Fujin run has helped her figure out her own path forward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And it's not just Mejiro Ryan. Everyone who sees Ines Fujin run finds themselves getting fired up. Her running fills countless people with energy and enthusiasm.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I imagine the cheers at the Satsuki Sho will be even louder. Everyone's hoping to see her do her best… and win.
